configurations.name: aavis-itdesk
configurations.//: Run through a shell that puts Homebrew's Node first. The default `node` on this machine is /usr/local/bin/node (v16), which Next 16 refuses to start on; Homebrew has v24 at /opt/homebrew/bin. A missing directory in PATH is ignored, so this stays harmless on machines where node is already current.
runtimeArgs: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"; exec npm run dev
